name: @molis-ai/molis-work-plugin-work-brief
description: Work Brief: a project's brief as the home's main page, its versions, sources and revisions; a personal brief across projects.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && esbuild src/browser/factory.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --minify --charset=utf8 '--banner:js=(host) => {' --footer:js=} --define:WORK_BRIEF_CSS="$(node tooling/minify-styles.mjs)" --outfile=dist/work-brief-client.js && node ../../../scripts/client-literals.mjs --factory dist/work-brief-client.js
